1.title: The Doll Shelf
1.text: Sabrina has gone silent in the back parlor, the way she does whenever the house grows too loud inside her head. You find her standing before her shelf of porcelain dolls. "You have been debating whether to ask me something for nine days," she says without turning. "Ask, or I will be forced to answer it unasked."

image.comp: turning from the doll shelf with one doll in her hands, deadpan expression softening, a faint almost-smile
image.setting: back room with a shelf of dolls, purple lamplight, drawn curtains

1.goRes: Her stoic composure holds for one heartbeat before she steps into you and kisses you deeply—and somewhere down the hall, a silver spoon bends quietly on a table.
1.waitRes: "Mm. I foresaw that answer." A beat. "I did not foresee it stinging. Interesting." She sets the doll back on its shelf with extreme care.

2.title: Quiet Hands
2.text: Sabrina has sat beside you through a chaotic night of rowdy patrons, quietly shielding the hall from intrusive thoughts. Finally alone on the upstairs settee, she takes your hand, sliding her cool fingers up your arm and down your chest. "You are carrying tension in four places—allow me." The candle flame bends steadily toward you both.

image.comp: sitting close on a settee, holding his hand in both of hers, calm gaze, a faint flush on her cheeks
image.setting: dim upstairs sitting room, purple curtains, one candle

2.goRes: Her cool hands unfasten your belt and find every sensitive nerve—and for once, the quietest woman in the house lets you hear her breathless, helpless sighs.
2.waitRes: "I decide when I have done enough." She relents, resting her head against your shoulder instead. "...Though this is acceptable."

3.title: Nothing Left to Read
3.text: "I cannot read your mind—not truly," Sabrina whispers in her doorway, her plum silk robe hanging parted over bare curves and a single candle glowing behind her. "You are loud, then silent, and I cannot predict you. That is precisely why I want you in my bed tonight. Come inside, Sam."

image.comp: standing in her doorway in a plum silk robe, hair loose, steady dark eyes, one hand extended
image.setting: her bedroom, purple silk bedding, a row of dolls on the sill, candlelight

3.goRes: She latches the door with a flick of her mind—and then with her hand—before letting the plum silk drop and sinking down onto you, gasping softly as every telepathic barrier shatters.
3.waitRes: "I am never unsure—occasionally afraid, which is tonight." She smiles faintly. "Take your time; I have already seen how this ends."

jump.title: All Thoughts at Once
jump.text: The psychic din of the evening finally breaks Sabrina's calm in the dusk-lit kitchen. Gripping the counter, then your collar, she pulls you flush against her. "Every person in this house is thinking about you tonight—and I intend to be the loudest," she breathes, kissing you hungrily while copper pots rattle on their hooks.

image.comp: gripping his collar, eyes closed, composure cracking, flushed, pulling him toward the door
image.setting: kitchen at dusk, copper pots, lamplight

jump.goRes: She hikes up her skirt on the kitchen counter and pulls you inside her, your thoughts fusing together while the entire house goes dead silent around you.
jump.waitRes: She stills, then nods slowly. "Yes—breathing. A primitive, effective tactic." She counts four slow breaths, fingers still curled in your collar.

1.title: A Fascinating Excavation
1.text: Cynthia has spent the week excavating the stone cellar behind the wine racks, convinced an ancient ruin lies beneath. You find her dusted to the elbows with a smudge across her cheek. "Do you know what I uncovered?" she smiles warmly, stepping close. "Nothing at all—and I couldn't be happier, because you came down to keep me company."

image.comp: kneeling then rising in the cellar with a brush in her hand, dust on her cheek, composed smile and warm eyes, close to him
image.setting: stone cellar lit by a lantern, wine racks, a half-cleared wall

1.goRes: She kisses with unhurried, thorough attention—parting her lips beneath yours before whispering breathlessly, "Fascinating. This requires further study."
1.waitRes: She lets out a genuine, low laugh. "Quite right—a Champion covered in cellar dust. Ask me again at supper."

2.title: Ruins by Lamplight
2.text: Cynthia spreads a yellowed map across your study desk and lays her warm hand directly over yours, her fingers trailing slowly up your wrist. "Ancient legends speak of two travelers meeting on a rainy night like this—and neither going home," she purrs, academic tone entirely undermined by the heat in her grey eyes. "I'd like to test that hypothesis."

image.comp: leaning over a desk with a yellowed map, her hand on his, composed smile with a hint of mischief
image.setting: study lit by a single oil lamp, maps and old books piled high

2.goRes: The yellowed map slides unheeded to the floorboards as she unfastens your trousers, exploring you with patient, scholarly devotion until you're gripping the edge of the desk.
2.waitRes: "Delightful—then I shall gather more." She rolls the map up unhurriedly. "Patience is most of archaeology, after all."

3.title: The Champion Takes a Night Off
3.text: Cynthia has let down her cascade of blonde hair and draped her black coat over a chair, standing beside her bed in a loose black silk robe that parts over bare thighs. "I have claimed every title I ever sought—yet you are the first thing I couldn't simply win by strength," she murmurs, holding out her hand. "Stay with me tonight, Sam."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of her bed in a black silk robe, hair down, calm and a little vulnerable, hand held out
image.setting: elegant guest room, black coat over a chair, soft gold lamplight

3.goRes: You slide the black silk off her shoulders and sink deep into her warmth, the undefeated Champion arching beneath you with breathless, unguarded moans all night long.
3.waitRes: "I am rarely uncertain—merely unaccustomed to asking." She smiles warmly. "Take whatever time you need; I excel at patience."

jump.title: Dust and Lamplight
jump.text: The cellar dig has finally uncovered ancient stonework, and Cynthia is far too exhilarated to stay dignified. Grabbing your hands in the lantern light, she laughs breathlessly and kisses you hard—again and again. "I'm not remotely sorry—I've wanted to do this since my third week here."

image.comp: laughing and breathless with dusty gloves on his shoulders, hair coming loose, radiant
image.setting: cellar after a successful dig, lanterns on crates

jump.goRes: Her legendary composure vanishes completely as she pulls you down onto the piled canvas tarps in the cellar, tearing at your clothes with dusty, eager hands.
jump.waitRes: "Of course." She presses a palm to her flushed cheek, trying for dignity. "I am a Champion—I can be slow. Watch me."

1.title: Sticky Notes
1.text: Juniper arrives forty minutes late to breakfast with three sticky notes clinging to her lab coat. When you peel one off—reading "tell Sam. SOON." in her loopy handwriting—she gasps, turning bright pink. "Oh! That was the reminder. May I... show you instead of trying to explain?"

image.comp: holding a sticky note to her chest, flustered, glasses slightly crooked, hopeful smile
image.setting: sunny breakfast room, papers and notebooks scattered across the table

1.goRes: She kisses you softly, then—ever the thorough researcher—kisses you again, deeper. "Right," she whispers breathlessly. "Hypothesis confirmed."
1.waitRes: "Eat! Yes, of course!" Blushing furiously, she sticks the note straight onto your cuff. "So you don't forget I asked."

2.title: Field Notes
2.text: Juniper has been scribbling field notes on the house for weeks, yet tonight her journal stays shut on the rooftop tiles beside two sticky-noted mugs of cocoa. Tugging you closer under her shared blanket, she rests a warm hand high on your thigh. "I keep writing your name in the margins—and I'd rather investigate hands-on."

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop ledge wrapped in a blanket with him, notebook beside her, soft blush and a shy smile
image.setting: house rooftop under a starry sky, chimney smoke, blanket and cocoa

2.goRes: Beneath the wool blanket under the stars, her curious, attentive fingers and soft lips explore every reaction while her forgotten notebook blows shut in the breeze.
2.waitRes: "Notes first," she agrees, tucking the blanket around your knees. "I like that you wait—it makes me want to be worth it."

3.title: A Very Late Night
3.text: "I'm late—I'm always late, except I refused to be late for this," Juniper says breathlessly in her doorway, lab coat discarded and auburn hair spilling loose over a thin sleeping shift. "Stay with me tonight, Sam. All night, if you'll have me."

image.comp: holding a teacup in the doorway of her room, hair down, glasses off, sincere and nervous
image.setting: her tidy room, books everywhere, a green lamp lit

3.goRes: She sets the forgotten teacup aside, pulls off her shift, and welcomes you into bed—enthusiastic, breathless, and finally right on schedule.
3.waitRes: "I'm sure of nearly everything about you." She smiles warmly. "Take a week—I'll draw up a very organized chart while I wait."

jump.title: Misplaced Inhibitions
jump.text: In the cramped supply closet, Juniper's stack of folders avalanches as she reaches for a lantern. You catch her flush against your chest—and she immediately kisses you with scattered, heartfelt urgency. "Sorry! Actually, not sorry—is a supply cupboard a terrible place for this?"

image.comp: caught in his arms among fallen folders, flushed and laughing, hair a mess, kissing him
image.setting: narrow supply cupboard, shelves of paper, dim lamp

jump.goRes: Her breathless giggle turns into a sharp gasp as you pin her against the shelves, hiking up her skirt among the fallen folders.
jump.waitRes: "Beds! Very sound methodology." She grabs your hand, adjusting her glasses. "Please lead—I'll definitely get lost."

1.title: Sun Hat
1.text: Leaf returns from wandering the market lanes with her white sun hat swinging from her fingers and a pocket full of smooth pebbles. Pressing a heart-shaped stone into your palm, she beams up at you. "Every town has one thing that makes me linger an extra day—and here, it's you. May I kiss you?"

image.comp: holding out a small heart-shaped stone, sun hat in the other hand, windblown hair, bright hopeful grin
image.setting: sunny front steps of the house at golden hour, market lane behind

1.goRes: She kisses you like she's discovering an uncharted route—bright, eager, and delighted—laughing softly against your lips.
1.waitRes: "That's completely okay!" She nods brightly, setting her hat back on. "Roads are long—I'll hold onto the stone until you're ready."

2.title: Off the Map
2.text: Leaf drags you up the grassy hill behind the house at dusk, spreading her jacket out on the earth and pulling you down beside her under the first fireflies. "I've traveled from the northern lights to the southern coast, and nowhere ever felt like this," she whispers, sliding her warm hands beneath your shirt.

image.comp: lying on a spread jacket in the grass, tugging him down, wide-open happy grin, sun hat beside her
image.setting: grassy hillside behind the house at dusk, town lanterns below

2.goRes: On the hillside above the town lanterns, her curious hands and soft mouth explore you unhurriedly, trading breathless giggles and gasps in the warm grass.
2.waitRes: "Okay!" She rests her head contentedly on your shoulder. "Best view I've ever found, honestly."

3.title: Journey's End, Maybe
3.text: Leaf has finally unpacked her travel bag—her vest hanging on a peg, her sun hat perched on the bedpost, and nothing on beneath an oversized shirt that slips off one bare shoulder. "I never unpack anywhere, Sam—until tonight. Stay in my bed."

image.comp: sitting cross-legged on a bed in an oversized shirt, empty travel pack beside her, soft smile
image.setting: cozy attic room, travel map pinned to the wall, warm lamp

3.goRes: You pull the oversized shirt over her head and sink slowly inside her, Leaf wrapping her legs around you and whispering "Home" against your neck as she shudders.
3.waitRes: "I've never been surer of a route in my life." She grins warmly. "Take your time—the map isn't going anywhere."

jump.title: Shortcut
jump.text: Leaf takes a wrong turn in the corridors again and bursts into your room soaked from an evening downpour, laughing breathlessly. Tossing her wet hat onto your chair, she kisses you hard before the thought even finishes. "Best wrong turn ever—is it alright if I strip off these wet clothes and stay?"

image.comp: shaking rain from her hair, laughing, leaning in to kiss him, wet jacket half off
image.setting: his bedroom on a rainy evening, window streaked with rain

jump.goRes: Rain drums against the windowpane all night while you peel away her soaked clothes and warm her up thoroughly in bed.
jump.waitRes: "Good call." She grabs a towel and grins over it. "Don't move—I find my way back fast."

1.title: After the Water Cools
1.text: Misty is draining the bathhouse for the night when you bring her a fresh stack of towels. Leaning on her mop with damp red hair clinging to her neck, she glares defensively through a bright blush. "You always help out—nobody else bothers. And I'm only red because of the steam!"

image.comp: leaning on a mop, damp hair in its side tail, blushing and defiant, stepping closer
image.setting: the empty bathhouse at closing, steam and tile, wooden buckets

1.goRes: She kisses like she battles—fierce and head-on at first, before softening with a breathless laugh against your mouth. "Okay... that's much better."
1.waitRes: "Fine," she huffs, cheeks scarlet. "Though I hate waiting—so you owe me."

2.title: Pool Rules
2.text: After hours, Misty challenges you to a lap race across the big bath—and wins effortlessly. Perched on the wet tile edge in her sea-blue swimsuit with water dripping off her bare thighs, she catches your wrists as you swim up. "Loser's penalty," she purrs, cheeks pink. "And I get to use my hands."

image.comp: perched on the edge of the pool in a sea-blue swimsuit, smug grin turning bashful, pulling him closer
image.setting: the bathhouse pool at night, lantern reflections on water

2.goRes: Her competitive smirk dissolves into breathless gasps as you pull her back into the warm water, slick hands exploring every curve beneath the surface.
2.waitRes: "Hah—coward!" She splashes warm water at your face. "Tomorrow, then—and I'm still picking the penalty."

3.title: Calm Waters
3.text: Misty's bedroom door stands ajar, and you find her sitting on the mattress with her boots lined up neatly and her red hair spilling unbound down her bare back. "I never do anything halfway, Sam," she mutters, meeting your eyes with fierce, flushed honesty. "If you stay tonight, I'm all in. Stay."

image.comp: sitting on the bed hugging her knees, hair loose, blunt but shy eyes, a little smile
image.setting: her small tidy room, a fish-shaped lamp, sea-blue blanket

3.goRes: She laughs softly at her own nerves, pulls you down onto the sea-blue sheets, and rides you with breathless, wholehearted intensity until morning.
3.waitRes: "Don't ask like I'm fragile!" Then, much quieter: "...Yes. Wait if you need to—I'll be ready."

jump.title: Cannonball
jump.text: A bathhouse prank goes sideways and Misty, furious and laughing, shoves you straight into the hot spring before diving in after you. Surfacing nose to nose in the thick steam, she wraps her arms around your neck and kisses you hungrily. "Definitely wasn't the plan—don't care."

image.comp: treading water with her arms around his neck, wet hair plastered down, wide-eyed, flushed
image.setting: the bathhouse pool with steam rising, lanterns overhead

jump.goRes: The steam closes around you both as you press her against the warm stone wall of the pool, shedding wet clothes in the water.
jump.waitRes: "Right—towels; I'm not a Goldeen." She climbs out, glancing back with a bright pink face.

1.title: Cleared Out
1.text: Clair has just tossed a handsy drunk bodily out into the street. You find her on the back step afterward, gloves off and jaw clenched tight. "Spare me the praise—I'm exhausted from always being impressive," she says, lifting proud, vulnerable eyes to yours. "For one minute, I just want to be held and kissed."

image.comp: sitting on a back step with her gloves in her lap, proud posture slipping, vulnerable eyes
image.setting: back step of the house at night, torchlight, rain-dark cobbles

1.goRes: She kisses you with intense, deliberate care—pulling back with cheeks flushed as crimson as her cape.
1.waitRes: Her pride flares briefly before softening. "Perhaps you're right—just don't mistake my patience for disinterest, Sam."

2.title: The Dragon Tamer's Hands
2.text: Clair sits you down in the torchlit training yard to rewrap your scraped knuckles, her firm fingers lingering along your wrist far longer than necessary. "You hold a quill poorly, a sword poorly, and me far too timidly," she murmurs, stepping between your knees. "Allow me to demonstrate proper grip."

image.comp: kneeling in front of him, wrapping his hand in cloth, proud half-smile, eyes lifting to his
image.setting: lantern-lit training yard, wooden dummies, evening wind

2.goRes: She guides your hands firmly over her hips and chest while dropping to her knees to work you with commanding, breathless precision.
2.waitRes: "I rarely repeat lessons." A pause. "...Tomorrow. Once. Don't make me regret it."

3.title: My Own Terms
3.text: Clair stands in her bedroom doorway barefoot in a midnight-blue silk gown, the gold clasps from her hair lined up neatly on the dresser like surrendered weapons. "I have earned every victory in my life—you are the first gift I choose to accept," she says softly, letting the gown slip off her shoulders. "Stay on my terms tonight."

image.comp: standing barefoot in a midnight-blue gown at her door, hair half-down, chin lifted but eyes soft
image.setting: her formal bedroom, gold-trimmed hangings, candles lit

3.goRes: She bolts the door with a sharp click, straddles your hips on the mattress, and lets every ounce of dragon-tamer pride melt into breathless cries beneath you.
3.waitRes: "Don't insult me." Then, softer: "I am—ask again in a few days if you must; my answer won't change."

jump.title: Provoked
jump.text: When a patron sneers that a proud woman has no place in a pleasure house, Clair's temper snaps. After throwing him out, she turns, spots you grinning, and fists your lapels. "Wipe that smirk off—I'm still furious," she growls, slamming her mouth onto yours while her cape hangs askew.

image.comp: gripping his lapels, flushed and fierce, chin up, pulling him in to kiss him
image.setting: entrance hall after a scuffle, door still swinging, lamps flickering

jump.goRes: Her fury channels straight into raw hunger as she hauls you up the stairs into her bedroom, tearing off her cape and gown.
jump.waitRes: "I am breathing!" She catches herself, exhales, and glares at the ceiling. "...Slowly, then. As you wish."

1.title: Spilled
1.text: Flannery is serving a late round when her elbow clips an entire tray of drinks straight into your lap. "Oh no—I'm so sorry!" she squeaks, dabbing frantically at your trousers with her apron before freezing at where her hands are, turning crimson, and kissing you on impulse.

image.comp: dabbing at his front with an apron, mortified red cheeks, leaning in for an impulsive kiss
image.setting: lively tavern floor after closing, spilled drinks, lantern light

1.goRes: You kiss her back properly, her flustered hands steadying on your shoulders as she laughs breathlessly. "Okay—that went way better than the tray."
1.waitRes: "Right—mop, on it!" She bolts toward the kitchen, glancing back twice with bright red cheeks.

2.title: Heat of the Moment
2.text: Flannery drags you up onto the tavern roof after closing for a staring contest until sunrise—and loses in four seconds flat because she's staring at your mouth. "Unfair—you're distracting," she mutters, ears blazing scarlet as she tugs you under her blanket and slides her warm hand down your stomach. "Let me cheat back."

image.comp: sitting close on a rooftop with a bottle of cider, red-faced, grinning, shoulder pressed against his
image.setting: tavern rooftop at pre-dawn, faint orange on the horizon

2.goRes: Loud everywhere else, up here she turns shy, breathless, and eager—working you beneath the blanket while the sunrise happens completely unnoticed.
2.waitRes: "Fine!" She laughs, slightly relieved. "Next sunrise, though, I'm not watching the sky."

3.title: Hot Enough
3.text: Flannery bursts through your bedroom door, shuts it gently, and takes a deep breath with her face burning bright red. "I rehearsed a whole speech and forgot every word—so here's the short version: I'm crazy about you, and I want to spend the night in your bed. Please?"

image.comp: standing in his doorway, hands behind her back, fierce blush, brave grin
image.setting: his room, window open, a candle burning, night air

3.goRes: She laughs in pure delight, drags you onto the mattress by both hands, and throws herself into you—warm, loud, and wholehearted until dawn.
3.waitRes: "I am—though ask me again tomorrow too," she grins. "No rush; I'm slow at this part."

jump.title: Last Call
jump.text: The tavern is empty and Flannery, tipsy on late-night cider, stares across the bar at you before vaulting right over the counter—knocking a stool over as she crashes into your arms and kisses you hungrily. "I'm done pretending I don't think about you naked!"

image.comp: climbing over a bar counter, stool toppling, laughing, flushed, kissing him
image.setting: late-night tavern bar, last candle burning

jump.goRes: Clumsy, fiery, and completely uninhibited, she pulls you down behind the bar counter, tugging at your belt and her own top.
jump.waitRes: "Only a little." She hops onto a stool. "Fine—water first, though I'll say it again tomorrow sober."

1.title: Ribbon
1.text: May is rehearsing a contest spin in the hallway with her red ribbon twirling when she catches her heel on a rug and lands mid-pirouette straight in your arms. Holding the pose with a bright blush, she whispers, "Ta-da? Nobody saw—and I'd like a kiss for my trouble."

image.comp: mid-pirouette caught in his arms, ribbon fluttering, laughing and blushing, close to his face
image.setting: sunlit upstairs hallway, rugs, ribbon trailing

1.goRes: She kisses you warmly before spinning out of your arms with a giggle, leaving her red ribbon draped across your shoulder.
1.waitRes: "Later!" She curtsies playfully, unbothered. "A great coordinator always leaves the audience wanting more."

2.title: After the Show
2.text: After the festival performance, May flops onto the dressing-room settee with her shoes kicked across the floor and ribbons tangled in her hair. When you bring her water, she pats the cushion beside her with a warm, breathless smile. "I smiled at hundreds of people tonight—yet you're the only one I wanted. Come here."

image.comp: sprawled on a dressing-room settee, ribbons tangled in her hair, tired glowing smile, patting the cushion
image.setting: backstage dressing room, mirror with bulbs, costumes on hooks

2.goRes: Her bubbly teasing softens into quiet, breathless sighs as your hands slide beneath her stage costume under the humming vanity lights.
2.waitRes: "Okay, coach." She rests her cheek against your shoulder with a sleepy giggle. "Rain check—my favorite part of any contest."

3.title: Encore
3.text: A crooked paper star is taped to May's bedroom door with a note: "Come in. Please. -M." Inside, she sits on the mattress in a thin white nightgown with her contest ribbons spread out beside her. "I wanted the final number to be just the two of us—stay for the encore?"

image.comp: sitting on her bed in a white nightgown with her ribbons laid out, shy and hopeful smile, hands clasped
image.setting: her cheerful room, ribbons on the wall, pink lamp

3.goRes: She laughs softly when she trips over her own slippers into your arms—before you peel off the white nightgown and make love to her all night long.
3.waitRes: "Mhm—slightly terrified, yet totally sure." She smiles brightly. "Take a day or two; encores can wait."

jump.title: Backstage Trip
jump.text: May trips over a stage cable behind the curtain and lands sprawled right on top of you—and instead of getting up, she kisses you upside down, laughing, before flipping around to straddle your hips. "That was the recovery move—now here's the grand finale."

image.comp: sprawled on top of him laughing, hair falling over his face, leaning down for a kiss
image.setting: backstage floor, cables and props, string lights overhead

jump.goRes: Behind the heavy stage curtain as the last patrons file out, she hikes up her contest dress and improvises a breathless, unforgettable routine.
jump.waitRes: "Mm—smart!" She bounces up and offers her hand with a grin. "Just don't let me trip on the stairs."

1.title: Challenger
1.text: Hilda corners you in the upstairs hallway with a cocky grin. "Bet you can't hold eye contact for ten seconds straight." You make it to nine before she blinks, flushes crimson, and mutters, "Cheater"—grabbing your sleeve to plant a fierce kiss on your lips before strutting off. "Best two out of three!"

image.comp: grabbing his sleeve with a competitive grin that falters into a blush, leaning up for a quick kiss
image.setting: bright upstairs hallway, doors open, laundry basket nearby

1.goRes: She only planned on one—so when you pull her back in for a second, deeper kiss, Hilda yelps breathlessly, "Okay, okay—you take this round!"
1.waitRes: "Ha—you're on!" She pokes a finger into your chest, grinning with bright red ears.

2.title: Loud Girls Go Quiet
2.text: Hilda spends the whole evening bragging about her travels until you're sitting together on the midnight stoop—where she suddenly runs out of stories and leans her warm shoulder into yours. "I talk nonstop so nobody notices I get shy about the best parts," she murmurs, sliding her hand onto your thigh. "And the best part is you."

image.comp: sitting on the stoop with her chin on her knees, loud grin gone soft, pink boots beside her
image.setting: front stoop of the house at midnight, street lantern, quiet town

2.goRes: Quiet for once in the midnight shadows, she lets your hands explore beneath her shorts while her eager fingers work at your belt.
2.waitRes: "Aw." She smiles, ruffled yet pleased, resting her cheek against your shoulder. "A long one, then—you asked for it."

3.title: Winner
3.text: "I hate losing—and I hate waiting even more," Hilda declares, leaning against your bedroom doorframe with her pink boots kicked off, hair loose, and an unbuttoned shirt hanging open over bare skin. "So I'm calling it: you and me, in bed, tonight. ...Please don't say no."

image.comp: leaning against a doorframe in a loose shirt, cocky smile faltering, pink boots off
image.setting: his room, one lamp, bed turned down

3.goRes: She lets out a triumphant whoop, claps both hands over her mouth, and tackles you onto the mattress—riding you breathless until the lamp burns out.
3.waitRes: "Loud-sure," she grins, tossing her hair. "Take your time—I'll bring snacks while I wait."

jump.title: Dare Accepted
jump.text: A tavern drinking dare demands she kiss the nearest person. Hilda glances at you, shrugs, and kisses you—except she doesn't pull back, the entire table falling dead silent as her hands grip your shoulders. "That started as a dare," she breathes against your lips. "It isn't one anymore."

image.comp: mid-dare grin gone sincere, hands on his shoulders, flushed, whisper-close
image.setting: tavern corner table, half-finished drinks, laughter in the background

jump.goRes: Leaving the stunned table behind, she grabs your hand and marches you straight upstairs to your bedroom, tearing at your clothes before the door even latches.
jump.waitRes: She lets out a shaky laugh. "Fair enough—tell me when it's for real." Her grin is brighter than ever.
